definitions: Sir Leonard Woolley (1880-1960) was a British archaeologist best known for his excavations at Ur in Mesopotamia.
A prominent figure in early 20th-century archaeology, he made significant contributions to the understanding of ancient Near Eastern civilizations.
examples: Leonard Woolley's work at Ur revealed much about Sumerian civilization.
The discoveries made by Leonard Woolley are still studied today.
Many consider Leonard Woolley to be one of the most influential archaeologists of his time.
